LanguageData.TMM_SyntheticTextiles.label: synthread synthesis
LanguageData.TMM_SyntheticTextiles.description: Develop a process to synthesize one unit of synthread from one cloth and one chemfuel at a fabrication bench. This is a new industrial process added by Turbo mega mod.
LanguageData.TMM_AdvancedTextiles.label: hyperweave synthesis
LanguageData.TMM_AdvancedTextiles.description: Develop a precise weaving process to produce one unit of hyperweave from one synthread and one chemfuel at a fabrication bench.
